text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — we need to scrub the exec-facing slides and run stakeholder deconflicts for the EBR on Thursday. Who can own slide deconflicts and demo timing?
Jon: I can take slide deconflicts. Will do a pass tonight and flag overlaps.
Priya: I’ll own the renewal risks section and pull the latest health signals. Sharing the risk spreadsheet in a bit. :memo:
Alex: I’ll coordinate the demo run and verify the playbook. Can we lock a dry-run on Wed 10:30am PT?
Ruth: Wed 10:30 works for me. I’ll prepare the cue cards and fallback talking points.
Carlos: Heads-up — onboarding cohort B has two blocked data syncs. That might move the adoption metric downward; Priya, should we surface as a high-risk item in the exec slide?
Priya: Yes, include it under "Adoption risks" with impact + mitigation. I’ll add a short note and assign owners.
Maya: Great. Jon, can you also reconcile duplicate asks across slide owners? There were two different metric calls for "DAU" vs "Active seats" last quarter.
Jon: On it. I’ll keep a changelog. Putting a tiny checklist in the deck comments:
```
- deconflict metrics
- confirm owners for each slide
- finalize exec bullets
- rehearse demo fallback
```
Alex: Deck link (latest): https://company.slack/shared/decks/ebrs/311222 — please use that.
deck-bot: calendar: EBR Dry-run scheduled: Wed 10:30am PT — invite sent to Maya, Alex, Ruth, Jon, Priya.
Ruth: Also capturing feedback asks: need an ask for a feature timeline and a clear renewal CTA. Where should that live?
Priya: Put it on the "Exec asks" slide and in the follow-up action tracker. I’ll create tasks in Asana after this thread.
Carlos: FYI — CS Ops will surface the onboarding ticket IDs in the action tracker so ENG knows what to prioritize.
Maya: Perfect. Two quick asks: 1) Jon, add a single-line summary on each slide for execs. 2) Everyone, add one hard ask (decision or approval) per slide so the exec readout is actionable.
Jon: Will add summaries tonight and ping when done.
Alex: Locking demo flow: happy path -> 2 fallback scenarios -> recovery slide. I’ll paste the flow in the deck notes.
Priya: I’ll prepare a 1-slide renewal risk heatmap for the execs. Need final health metrics by Tue EOD.
Maya: Noted. If anyone can’t meet their deliverable, please say so now. Otherwise we’ll assume owners are ✅.
Carlos: All good from Ops, will add ticket links by EOD tomorrow.
Ruth: I’ll share cue cards by Tue 9am PT.
Jon: Done — slide deconflict pass complete. Left comments on 6 slides. @Maya @Priya please review. :mag:
Maya: Reviewing now, thanks Jon. I’ll consolidate comments and circulate a single deck version by Wed morning.
Priya: After I add the heatmap, I’ll tag eng owners for mitigation plans.
Alex: Confirmed for Wed dry-run. Will bring stopwatch and timing notes. :stopwatch:
Maya: Thanks team — this helped. We’ll reconvene at the dry-run and capture final asks. :raised_hands:
